paper: EvoTest: Self-Evolving Agent for Test Suite Generation with Repository Context
description: Sensitivity analysis of EvoTest's three key parameters

constraint_memory_merge_threshold.name: Constraint Memory Merge Threshold
constraint_memory_merge_threshold.description: Controls deduplication rate in Constraint Memory (per-repository patterns)

refinement_memory_merge_threshold.name: Refinement Memory Merge Threshold
refinement_memory_merge_threshold.description: Controls deduplication rate in Refinement Memory (cross-repository debugging insights)

jit_retrieval_threshold.name: JIT Retrieval Threshold
jit_retrieval_threshold.description: Controls similarity threshold for Just-In-Time Retrieval from Refinement Memory

jit_relevance_analysis.description: Manual analysis of retrieval relevance for triggered cases

data.note: Low precision: many cross-repo irrelevant insights
